name: Analisis de Cadencia del Habla
description: Analiza el ritmo, la velocidad y los patrones de prosodia para detectar voz generada por IA en videos.
useCase: Detecting synthetic speech in deepfake videos through temporal speech pattern analysis
mechanism: Extracts speech rate, pause duration, pitch contour, and emphasis patterns from audio tracks. Natural speech has characteristic variability in cadence, while AI-generated speech often shows unnatural uniformity or periodic patterns in rhythm and intonation.
source: MÃ¼ller et al. (2022) - Does Audio Deepfake Detection Generalize?, Interspeech
algorithm: Prosody Feature Extraction + Temporal Pattern Analysis + Statistical Deviation Scoring
parameters: Window: 500ms, Features: F0 contour, speech rate, pause ratio, jitter, shimmer
